title: French Date Crumble
description: A French dessert made with sweet dates and topped with a crunchy crumble mixture, perfect for a sweet treat.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the pitted dates and granulated sugar. Mix until well combined.
In a separate bowl, mix together the broken Mexican bowl pieces and flour.
Add the cold unsalted butter to the flour mixture and mix until crumbly.
Pour the date mixture into a baking dish and top with the crumble mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the crumble is golden brown.
